notes: Note: Set 1 ended early due to FOH outage. The setlist mimicked that of a 1994 setlist in reference to this being Phish's 94th performance at Madison Square Garden and featured Trey and Mike wearing outfits typical for them in 1994

songs.name: The Ed Sullivan Show introduction
songs.notes: (Back in the U.S.S.R. was preceded by an intro from The Ed Sullivan Show (also done Oct 31, 1994))

songs.name: Wolfman's Brother
songs.notes: (ended 7 minutes in due to FOH outage)

songs.name: Tweezer
songs.notes: (-> "Down With Disease" reprise > "Tweezer" (Trey teased "Mind Left Body Jam") >)

songs.name: Catapult
songs.notes: (with "None compare" vocal breakdown) (last played 9/5/2021, aka 223 shows) (-> "Tweezer" >)

songs.name: Purple Rain
songs.notes: (Prince cover) (last played 7/4/2012, aka 535 shows) (Fish on vacuum; Trey switched to guitar halfway through)
